# nomatron_organization_member (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron organization member by organization name and username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_organization_member" "example" {
  org_name = "platform"
  username = "rbarnes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_name` (String) Organization name.
- `username` (String) Username to look up within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `joined_at` (String) Timestamp when the user joined the organization.
- `user_id` (String) User ID for the organization member.
